name: BT-series ordnance droid
description: The BT-series ordnance droid, also known simply as BT droids, were a model of loader droid manufactured by Baktoid Fleet Ordnance. Designed to load and unload ordnance systems, the droids had extensive knowledge of the material they worked with. Although most BT-series droids had stiff and business-like personalities, some developed a more cavalier and daredevil attitude when dealing with explosives. During the Galactic Civil War, some BT-series droids served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
